items.title: NetApp Earnings Beat Estimates. The Stock Is Falling Anyway.
items.summary: The company’s fiscal first-quarter revenue grew 30% to $2.03 billion, beating Wall Street estimates of $1.84 billion.

items.title: NetApp (NTAP) Surpasses Q1 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
items.summary: NetApp (NTAP) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +21.13% and +9.86%, respectively, for the quarter ended July 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: NetApp Stock Slides Despite Earnings Beat
items.summary: NetApp stock slid late Wednesday despite the enterprise data storage firm reporting fiscal Q1 results easily ahead of views.

items.title: NetApp (NASDAQ:NTAP) Delivers Strong Q2 CY2026 Numbers But Stock Drops
items.summary: Data storage company NetApp (NASDAQ:NTAP) reported Q2 CY2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 29.9% year on year to $2.03 billion. On top of that, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($2.1 billion at the midpoint) was surprisingly good and 13.2% above what analysts were expecting. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.58 per share was 21.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: NetApp (NTAP) May Find a Bottom Soon, Here's Why You Should Buy the Stock Now
items.summary: NetApp (NTAP) witnesses a hammer chart pattern, indicating support found by the stock after losing some value lately. This coupled with an upward trend in earnings estimate revisions could mean a trend reversal for the stock in the near term.
